title: Michaelis-Menten Enzyme Kinetics
description: Single-compartment enzymatic substrate-to-product conversion governed by a saturating Michaelis-Menten rate law with explicitly declared kinetic parameters.

title: Gardner Genetic Toggle Switch
description: Bistable mutual-repression synthetic gene circuit (LacI and TetR) exhibiting two stable expression states under cooperative Hill repression kinetics.

title: SIR Epidemiological Model with Vaccination Event
description: Susceptible-Infected-Recovered population dynamics with conserved total headcount assignment rule and a discrete public-health vaccination campaign event.

title: Modular Metabolic Pathway with Imported Enzyme Module
description: Multi-file biochemical pathway composing a reusable enzymatic kinetics submodel imported from an external Antimony library file.

title: Multi-Compartment Glucose-Insulin Homeostasis
description: Whole-body physiological glucose-insulin regulation integrating plasma kinetics with modular pancreatic beta-cell secretion and hepatic glycogenolysis submodels.
